teaser.en: Crush a leaf and it smells of citrus, a clue that this prickly climber is a cousin of the orange.
teaser.sw: Ponda jani lake na litanuka kama limau, ishara kwamba mtambaa huu wenye miiba ni binamu wa mchungwa.

summary.en: *Mtseha* is a prickly woody climber of forest edges and thicket, with citrus-scented leaves and small orange berries. The Digo of Diani boil its root bark as a remedy for malaria.
summary.sw: *Mtseha* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba wa kando ya misitu na vichaka vizito, wenye majani yanayonukia kama limau na beri ndogo za rangi ya chungwa. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi yake kama dawa ya malaria.

about.en:
*Mtseha* is a woody climber armed with hooked prickles on its stems. Each leaf has three glossy leaflets, and when crushed they give off a strong citrus scent, a reminder that it belongs to the same family as oranges and limes.

Its flowers are small and greenish-white, and they are followed by small round berries that ripen orange. The root has a yellow inner bark.
about.sw:
*Mtseha* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu na miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano kwenye mashina yake. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu vinavyong'aa, na vikipondwa hutoa harufu kali ya limau, ukumbusho kwamba ni wa familia moja na michungwa na midimu.

Maua yake ni madogo ya rangi ya kijani-nyeupe, na hufuatiwa na beri ndogo za mviringo zinazoiva zikawa za rangi ya chungwa. Mzizi una gome la ndani la manjano.

where.en: Look for *mtseha* along forest edges and in thicket, where it scrambles over shrubs and into trees. The smell of the crushed leaves is the quickest way to confirm it.
where.sw: Mtafute *mtseha* kando ya misitu na katika vichaka vizito, ambako hutambaa juu ya vichaka na kupanda mitini. Harufu ya majani yaliyopondwa ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuuthibitisha.

uses.en: The Digo of Diani boil the root bark of *mtseha* to make a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi ya *mtseha* kutengeneza dawa ya malaria.

names.en: Digo: *mtseha*. English: orange climber. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Toddalia asiatica*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mtseha*. Kwa Kiingereza: *orange climber*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Toddalia asiatica*.

reason.sw: Mdimu, ndugu anayepandwa katika familia ya michungwa

reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wenye harufu nzuri wa familia ya michungwa
Mjafari, mti wenye miiba wa familia ya michungwa
